title: SSO Authentication
description: Sarah signs in via Keycloak SSO. Her identity is verified and a JWT is issued with her groups and roles.

steps.label: Navigate to Login
steps.description: User opens the DeepSecure dashboard and is redirected to the identity provider

steps.label: Authenticate with IdP
steps.description: Keycloak validates credentials and issues an authorization code

steps.label: Token Exchange
steps.description: BFF exchanges the authorization code for a JWT containing user groups and roles

steps.label: Session Established
steps.description: Encrypted session cookie is set and user lands on the dashboard
